levels.surface: محمد بن الحسين بن أبي الخطاب

notes: «حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي» is a relation (rule 7); the dual «قالا» pairs him with «محمد [بن] الحسن» in one level (rule 2)
The brackets around «بن» are an editor's insertion; the surface keeps them as written
The Imam follows «عن» inside the chain: narrator (owner ruling 2); «قُلْتُ لَهُ» is the reporter's question
